name: 后台值守 Watchdog (App)
description: App plugin: Two switches (守护 TraeWork / 守护 ChatGPT) on a sub-page. When ON, the plugin spins up two internal setInterval loops (30s status poll + 2min ensureRunning cron) that call the corresponding atomic's extension points. The atomic only restarts when the target has exited and NEVER disturbs a live instance.
